text: Or, to the writers that write grieuousnesse.
Or, woe to the Assyrian. , Heb. Asshur. , Or, though.
Heb. to lay them a treading.
2.Kings 19.31. , Heb. visite vpon. , Heb. of the greatnesse of the heart.
Or, as if a rod should shake them that lift it vp. , Or, that which is not wood.
Heb. from the soule and euen to the flesh.
Cha 28.22 rom.9.27. , Heb. in or amongst. , Or, in.
Or, but hee shall lift vp his staffe for thee. , Exod. 14.
Heb. crie shrill with thy voice.
